subject: ClearSight POC — auth handshake, success criteria & access timeline
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Khan <sara.khan@clearsighthealth.com>, Mike Hart <mike.hart@clearsighthealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: ClearSight POC — auth handshake, success criteria & access timeline

Hi Sara / Mike — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have agreement before we start provisioning: 

What ClearSight told us on the call
- Primary goal: route clinical-transcription summaries into triage workflows and measure 85%+ intent-classification accuracy on theProduction-like sample set.
- Key constraints: PHI must remain in customer-controlled VPC for the trial; latency targets are 200–400ms p50 for 1–3k qps simulated load.

Proposed success criteria (draft, attached in spreadsheet):
- Accuracy: >=85% intent match on the 2k labeled sample (see poc-success-criteria.xlsx)
- Latency: p50 < 400ms, p95 < 800ms during 1k qps synthetic traffic
- Stability: zero service interruptions >5min over a 72-hour run
- Cost/throughput telemetry accessible to ClearSight via console + tokenized reports

Access & auth items we need from ClearSight to get started
1) Primary SSO admin email to invite for IdP setup (SAML).
2) Static egress IPs to allowlist on your side for initial test harness (we'll provide these).
3) A short list of 50 representative transcripts (sanitized) we can use for baseline runs.

Redwood provisioning plan & ownership
- Today (Jonas): deliver onboarding doc + skeleton success-criteria spreadsheet (attached).
- Mon (Marissa): send SSO invite and coordinate IdP test account with ClearSight IT.
- Tue (Aditya): provide API keys, temp sandbox credentials, and initial load script.
- Wed–Fri (Vivek): run baseline eval, capture latency/accuracy, and send a 48-hour stability window.

Proposed timeline (adjustable)
- Week 0 (this week): confirm SSO admin + allowlist entries; sign off on success criteria
- Week 1: provision sandbox, hand off keys, and run baseline tests
- Week 2: 72-hour stability run + joint review

Attachments: poc-success-criteria.xlsx (baseline metric matrix); redwood-poc-onboarding.pdf (short onboarding checklist).

Please reply with who on your side will be the SSO admin and who will own network allowlist. If the timeline above looks OK we’ll start IdP invites tomorrow morning.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Sr. Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com

From: Sara Khan <sara.khan@clearsighthealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mike Hart <mike.hart@clearsighthealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T17:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ClearSight POC — auth handshake, success criteria & access timeline

Jonas — thanks for the clear summary. Quick answers from our side: 

- SSO admin: Myself (Sara Khan), IT backup is Mike Hart. Please send the IdP (SAML) invite to sara.khan@clearsighthealth.com.
- Network allowlist: we have a network lead (Teresa) who needs the static IPs; copy mike.hart and I and we’ll route to her.
- Sample data: we can share 50 sanitized transcripts by Monday EOD — I’ll have a secure upload link.

One clarification on success criteria: the 85% intent match is acceptable but we also need to track a secondary metric — false positive rate for escalation triggers (must be <6%). Can you add that to the spreadsheet?

Timeline: the proposed timeline looks good; we’d prefer the 72-hour stability window in Week 2 to start on Thursday to align with our QA schedule.

Thanks — Sara
Sara Khan
Head of Product | ClearSight Health
sara.khan@clearsighthealth.com

Next operational items from Redwood (we’ll action once you confirm SSO admin and allowlist contact):
- SSO: I’ll send the SAML invite to sara.khan@clearsighthealth.com today. It will contain a test user flow and a short checklist that your IdP admin can use.
- IPs: temporary test egress IPs (for allowlist) — 34.82.129.47, 35.203.88.12, 35.201.19.200 (these are for sandbox only). Please share Teressa/NetOps contact or forward to them.
- API access: Aditya will provision a sandbox API key (scoped, 7-day) and send it via our secure vault link.

Attachments included: poc-success-criteria.xlsx; redwood-poc-onboarding.pdf

Marissa — can you send the SSO invite after I get confirmation from Sara? Aditya — please queue a sandbox key and note the 7-day TTL. Vivek — plan to run baseline tests Tue morning.

—Jonas
